plainTranslation: Emotional security that comes easily. Quiet commitment, dependable warmth, the sense of being safely held. Failure mode: steady drifts toward flat if no one adds heat. Use the stability to commit to something lasting, and keep warmth deliberate so it doesn't go quiet.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Imported from approved project marquee synastry aspect material. Source file was not copied into the repository.
